coordinates: Metres in the standard YAM station: x forward, y left, z up.

paper.orientation: 210 mm edges parallel to x; upper sheet shifted 12 mm along +y. Both sheets remain free.
paper.reset_settling: Spawn the flat stapled stack 0.7 mm above the document support. Native gravity/contact must settle and drape both sheets over the clinched tails and support edge. No paper pins or shape edits. Settled shape and tool access are not validated.

staple.material: galvanized low-carbon steel; constitutive parameters uncalibrated
staple.installation: Crown midpoint 12 mm inside the left edge and 12 mm inside the upper sheet front edge (24 mm from the lower front edge). Both legs pass through explicit holes and clinch inward below the lower sheet; geometry is not scaled up for extraction.

remover.start_orientation: Grip along y, fork tips point +y. Heel and grip rest on tabletop. The native tool must pivot by physical support contact; no grasp attachment.

assessor_tools: A millimetre ruler, backlight and before/after photographs of both sides of both sheets; not used to help the robot.
implementation_status: Full native scene authored in full_scene.py; not runtime validated.

document_support.purpose: Supports staple and remover fulcrum. Lower/upper far sheet edges overhang 20/32 mm for later separation; no attachments.
